definitions.explanation: The row or line at the front, whether of seats, people, or a formation.

examples.japanese: {前列|ぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat in the front row.

examples.japanese: {前列|ぜんれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{埋|う}まっている→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧。
examples.english: The front row seats are already taken.

examples.japanese: {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧とき、⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前列|ぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When we take the group photo, shorter people please line up in the front row.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (front) + ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). Used for seating, formations, and lineups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前列|ぜんれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: front row seat
- ⟦{最前列|さいぜんれつ}→最前列：17707_saizenretsu⟧: the very front row
- {前列|ぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in the front row
- {前列|ぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand in the front row

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後列|こうれつ}→後列：20218_kouretsu⟧: back row — the antonym
- ⟦{最前列|さいぜんれつ}→最前列：17707_saizenretsu⟧: very front row — the superlative
- ⟦{前方|ぜんぽう}→前方：19125_zenpou⟧: the front (area) — refers to a general area, not a row
